parakeet: Belief isn't impressive because someone smart has it. Belief is only impressive if it holds up to scrutiny. After someone hears the smartest man in the world believes in Jesus, the question they rarely ask is, what does it actually mean to be smart? That's where we flip the whole premise. I'm not just critiquing Young Hoon Kim. I'm using this moment to teach the public how to think better about intelligence itself. So what does SMART actually mean?
